sentences.text: ORDER % 22.03.2023 CRL.M.A. 7536/2023 (Exemption) Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

1. This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR No.425/2022, under Sections 420/120B IPC, registered at Police Station Gandhi Nagar, Delhi, and all proceedings emanating therefrom.
Learned APP appears on advance notice, and accepts notice.
3. It is submitted by the counsel for the petitioner that the matter is purely civil in nature.

It is further submitted that petitioner has filed anticipatory bail application before this Court, and in that application State has filed the status report, wherein it was mentioned that nothing incriminating has come against the petitioner during the course of investigation.
4. Learned APP seeks time to file the status report.

5. Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing.
6. Issue notice to respondent no.2 by all permissible modes, on the petitioner taking the necessary steps, returnable on 14th August, 2023.
RAJNISH BHATNAGAR, J MARCH 22, 2023/ib
